title: Tax Lines Presented in a Currency Other than US Dollars on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Air tickets sell under Air Ticket Fare Brands, and the tax lines posted on a booking are not always presented in US dollars. These points of judgement settle the rate at which conversion is held back from the amount the tax lines are returned at when such a booking has been given up.

**When does anything at all fall to be held back for conversion?** Only where the tax lines on the booking were presented in a currency other than US dollars. Where every tax line posted on the booking was presented in US dollars, nothing is held back for conversion.

**What is held back where the conversion markup of the fare brand held is at or above the markup band?** The markup band is 3.00 percent. Where the tax lines on the booking were presented in a currency other than US dollars and the conversion markup of the fare brand held is at or above that band, the conversion markup of the fare brand held is held back from the amount the tax lines are returned at.

**And where that markup is below the band?** Where the tax lines on the booking were presented in a currency other than US dollars and the conversion markup of the fare brand held is below 3.00 percent, half the conversion markup of the fare brand held is held back from the amount the tax lines are returned at.

**What is the conversion markup of each fare brand?**

| Fare brand | Conversion markup |
| --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 3.50 percent |
| Economy Saver | 3.50 percent |
| Economy Classic | 3.00 percent |
| Economy Flex | 3.00 percent |
| Premium Economy Select | 2.50 percent |
| Business Saver | 2.00 percent |
| Business Flex | 1.50 percent |

**Where does the band fall among the brands?** Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver stand at 3.50 percent, above the band, and Economy Classic and Economy Flex stand exactly at 3.00 percent, which is at the band; on a booking of any of those four brands whose tax lines were presented in another currency, the whole of that brand's markup is held back from the amount the tax lines are returned at, 3.50 percent or 3.00 percent as the brand held gives it. Premium Economy Select at 2.50 percent, Business Saver at 2.00 percent and Business Flex at 1.50 percent all stand below the band, and on such a booking half of the brand's markup is held back from that same figure, which is 1.25 percent, 1.00 percent and 0.75 percent respectively.
